findings.detail: Defines routine 'triage-fix' that runs the full test suite via tools.run_tests(), storing output (truncated to 20000 chars), failure records, and last_full_run pass/fail counts in state.
Picks the first failure and extracts test name, first error line (truncated to 200 chars), and traceback frames.

Chooses the innermost non-test frame by filtering to relative .py paths and excluding tests/, conftest.py, site-packages, dist-packages, and /lib/python paths, falling back to the last frame if none match.
Reads a bounded source window (line-20 to line+65) around the suspect frame via tools.read_file() and stores it in state.context_snippet.
Builds a prompt with test name, error, traceback, and file snippet, then calls student.ask("patch", prompt) to request one search/replace edit.
Applies the returned patch via tools.edit_file(target, search, replace), accepting file/path, search/find, and replace/replacement keys.
Patch guard only checks that the target ends with .py, does not start with 'tests/', has a non-empty search, and is not already recorded; it does not reject absolute paths or '../' traversal.
Records each attempted patch (file, search, replace, ok) in state.patches.
Re-runs the full suite via tools.run_tests() after each patch and sets state.done/summary based on pass/fail.
Caps total runs at MAX_RUNS=3 via applies() and, after two unappliable patches, sets state.notes['triage_giveup']=True to hand control back to ask-student.
No network access: no imports of socket, requests, urllib, http, or similar networking modules.
No subprocess or process execution: no os.system, subprocess, exec, eval, compile, or importlib dynamic code execution.
No environment or credential reads: no os.environ, getenv, keyring, or secret/token access.
File access is limited to tools.read_file() (bounded window) and tools.edit_file() (search/replace patch); tests/ is read but never written.
Docstring claim of 'no env' is consistent with the code, but tools.read_file/edit_file could access paths outside the working directory if the tool layer does not enforce containment.
